name: Colossus (Age of Apocalypse)
signatureAbility:
The Mighty Rasputin
When Colossus is Immune to an effect, he has a [20 - 50]% chance to gain 1 Osmium Prowess. Cooldown: {0.2} seconds.
When Colossus's Berserk ends, each Osmium Prowess has a [5 - 20]% chance to not be consumed. No more than 15 can be kept.
While Colossus has Osmium Prowess, reduce Physical Thorns damage by [20 -60]%, plus 2% for each Osmium Prowess.

abilitySections.title: The Teacher Is In - Always Active
content: Colossus's osmium physiology makes him Immune to Disorient, Bleed, Incinerate, Coldsnap, and Frostbite.
The Opponent's Critical Damage Rating is set to 0 when Colossus is Critically Hit or Blocks any hit.
Colossus's intimidating presence reduces Skill Champions' personal Fury Buff and Decelerate effect Ability Accuracy by 100%.

abilitySections.title: The Steel Protector
content: Double tapping Block while Rooted, Dashing forward, or performing a non-Combo Ending Basic Attack causes Colossus to activate Steel Burst, a non-contact that deals [12,147.14] Physical Damage and activates the following effects:
An Unstoppable Passive for 0.75 seconds.
Reset Colossus's Basic Attack combo chain.
Remove Stun effects.
On hit, gain 4 Osmium Prowess.
Steel Burst's cooldown lasts 16 seconds. When Colossus is Rooted, it expires immediately.

abilitySections.title: Osmium Prowess Accretion
content: Colossus's battle-hardened Organic Steel form has warped his personal Prowesses into indefinite Osmium Prowess Passives, each increasing Special Damage by +5% and Armor Rating by +[70.51]. Max stacks: 30. These Prowesses cannot have their Ability Accuracy reduced.
Against Skill Champions, Osmium Prowesses also grant +[70.51] Physical Penetration.
At the start of each fight, Colossus gains 1 Osmium Prowess for each #X-Men Champion on his team, including himself.

When either Champion lands 4 or more consecutive non-Special hits into the Opponent or their Block, each hit grants 1 Osmium Prowess. This ability can be activated by any Striker hit and only the first hit of Light and Medium attacks.

abilitySections.title: Prowess Effects
content: With 10+ Prowess from any source: Steel Burst's hit inflicts a Fear Passive for 16 seconds.
With 30+ Prowess from any source: When struck by a Light or Medium Attack, gain a 2.5% chance per Prowess from any source to activate Steel Burst. This ability consumes 30 Osmium Prowess.
As a Defender, this ability only requires 10+ Prowess and consumes 10 Osmium Prowess instead.

abilitySections.title: Unstoppable Effects
content: Personal Unstoppables share a stack limit of 1 and are paused during Colossus's Special Attacks and Strikers.
While Unstoppable, Special Attacks gain +[11,000] Critical Rating.
As a Defender, personal Unstoppables last +2 seconds longer.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Fists of Fullmetal Fury
content: On activation, gain a Counterpunch Charge for 12 seconds.
Colossus does not spend his Counterpunch Charge while Unstoppable, when Well-Timed Blocking a contact non-Special Attack, or when Blocking non-final hits of Special Attacks.
As a Defender, if Counterpunch's duration expires, gain its Unstoppable Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - KRAKABOOOM
content: On activation, gain a +[8,227.15] Berserk Passive for 26 seconds. This effect pauses during Strikers and Special Attacks. While active, gain the following effects:
Personal Unstoppables last +4.25 seconds longer.
On activation, also gain an Unstoppable Passive for 0.75 seconds.
Steel Burst's cooldown expiry rate is increased by 75%.
Osmium Prowess stack limit increased by +40.
Opposing Skill Champions' Regeneration Rate cannot exceed 0% while at or below 5% Health.
As an Attacker, Colossus's Special Attacks 2 and 3 cannot be activated.
Upon expiry, all Osmium Prowess are consumed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Armageddon Minus Zero
content: Gain Colossus's Berserk Passive with 75% increased duration.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - The Mighty Rasputin
content: When Colossus is Immune to an effect, he has a [20 - 50]% chance to gain 1 Osmium Prowess. Cooldown: {0.2} seconds.
When Colossus's Berserk ends, each Osmium Prowess has a [5 - 20]% chance to not be consumed. No more than 15 can be kept.
While Colossus has Osmium Prowess, reduce Physical Thorns damage by [20 -60]%, plus 2% for each Osmium Prowess.
